spec_match.rationale: Uses the spec's own motivating composition — animating text-decoration-inset from 100% 0 to 0 — against the legacy background-gradient hack, with the wrapping failure measured via getClientRects rather than asserted.

interactive.rationale: Hoverable/focusable links, a wrap-squeeze checkbox, a descenders toggle and a Measure button all drive the comparison; verified the squeeze toggle re-measured 1 to 3 line boxes and updated the table row and narration.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the sweep-in underline both ways with the wrap breakdown, which is what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Wrapping, descenders, reduced-motion (transitions disabled under prefers-reduced-motion) and the unsupported browser are all handled with distinct honest states.

conformance.rationale: The suite's percentage and two-value assertions are exactly the 100% 0 form this page animates; on Chromium 141 the route honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail since the property needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): toggled squeeze — gradientRects/realRects both measured 3 and the narration explained the gradient's single-bar failure; amber banner correctly noted the static right-hand underline on this pre-154 build; console clean, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and emits a reveal-compared assert with narrow/rect counts/support each report.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout including both link treatments, button colour pair overridden together, captioned comparison table with text verdicts.

accessibility.rationale: Both effects trigger on :focus-visible as well as hover, controls are labelled with 44px targets, the readout is aria-live, and reduced motion is respected.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); panels stack and code blocks scroll internally. Hover is unavailable on touch but focus/tap still exercises the links and the measurement tooling is pointer-independent.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/css-text-decoration-inset/reveal-effect/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which lacks text-decoration-inset. The comparison still earns its keep on this build: the wrap measurement (1 line box to 3 on squeeze) and the capability table are live evidence, while the amber banner honestly states that the right-hand link's animation needs Chrome 154. Reduced-motion and focus-visible handling are both present. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop 1280 and mobile 360 DPR3 screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail on this build. Clears the bar with no follow-ups.
